fine: Correct AtliQ entity: Pvt Ltd for a India counterparty
Parties = invoicing entity: Pvt Ltd throughout
Governing law matches entity: laws of India (Pvt Ltd → Indian law)
Delay penalties capped: Cap 5% of milestone
Liability capped: each Party's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement
Liquidated damages are correctly capped at 5% of the milestone fee, exclude client-caused delay, and are the sole remedy for delay.
The aggregate liability cap is mutual and set at 1x fees, with standard carve-outs for fraud and wilful misconduct.
Mutual indemnity for negligence and breach is standard; note that IP infringement is safely included under the general liability cap.
Ownership of specific deliverables transfers to the client only upon payment, and AtliQ retains all background IP and tools.
The 30-day convenience termination notice is reasonable and ensures AtliQ is paid for pro-rata work in progress.
Confidentiality terms are mutual with a standard 3-year survival period and appropriate exclusions.
The performance warranty is standard and includes a clear 30-day window for correcting any material non-conformities.
The agreement contains no non-compete or non-solicit restrictions on AtliQ.

guest review analytics solution for all twelve (12) Properties listed in Annexure B, comprising:
   (a) automated ingestion of guest reviews from up to six (6) online sources and BlueOrchid's post-stay survey tool;
   (b) multilingual sentiment and aspect analysis (English, Hindi, Arabic) covering room, cleanliness, F&B, service, location and value;

4.2 The Pilot shall run for a period of sixteen (16) weeks from the Effective Date, comprising a twelve (12) week build and rollout phase and a four (4) week evaluation phase.
4.3 BlueOrchid shall nominate a single point of contact (initially Ms. Farah Sayed, Director – Guest Experience) and shall provide timely access to data sources, systems and personnel reasonably required by AtliQ.
4.4 Any change in scope shall be documented through a written change request agreed by both Parties.

## 5. FEES AND PAYMENT

5.1 The total fee for the Pilot is USD 38,000 (United States Dollars Thirty-Eight Thousand only), payable in accordance with the Milestones in Annexure C.
5.2 AtliQ shall raise an invoice on completion of each Milestone. BlueOrchid shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.
5.3 All amounts are exclusive of GST, which shall be charged at the applicable rate. BlueOrchid may deduct TDS as required under the Income-tax Act, 1961, and shall furnish TDS certificates within the statutory timelines.
5.4 Any disputed portion of an invoice shall be notified within ten (10) days of receipt; the undisputed portion shall be paid in accordance with Clause 5.2.

## 6. TERM AND TERMINATION

6.1 This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and remain in force until completion of the Pilot, unless terminated earlier.
6.2 Either Party may terminate this Agreement for material breach not remedied within thirty (30) days of written notice.
6.3 BlueOrchid may terminate this Agreement for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, subject to payment for all work performed up to the effective date of termination, including a pro-rata amount for any Milestone in progress.
6.4 Clauses 7, 8, 10, 11, 13 and 14 shall survive termination or expiry.

## 7. CONFIDENTIALITY

7.1 Each Party shall hold the other Party's confidential information in strict confidence, use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and disclose it only to its employees and professional advisers on a need-to-know basis.
7.2 These obligations shall not apply to information that is public, already known to the recipient, independently developed, or required to be disclosed by law.
7.3 The obligations in this Clause shall continue for three (3) years after termination or expiry of this Agreement.

## 8. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

8.1 Upon payment in full, BlueOrchid shall own the dashboards, reports and configurations created specifically for BlueOrchid under this Agreement.
8.2 Each Party retains all rights in its Pre-existing IP. AtliQ grants BlueOrchid a non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-free licence to use AtliQ's Pre-existing IP to the extent incorporated in the Deliverables, solely for BlueOrchid's internal business purposes.
8.3 BlueOrchid retains all rights in Client Data.

## 9. WARRANTIES

9.1 AtliQ warrants that the Services shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by suitably qualified personnel.
9.2 AtliQ shall correct any material non-conformity in the Deliverables notified within thirty (30) days after completion of the Pilot.
9.3 Each Party warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement.

## 10. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

10.1 Neither Party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, including loss of profit, revenue or goodwill.
10.2 Except for breach of confidentiality, fraud or wilful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement.

## 11. INDEMNITY

11.1 Each Party (the "Indemnifying Party") shall indemnify the other against third-party claims to the extent arising from the Indemnifying Party's breach of this Agreement, negligence or wilful misconduct.
11.2 AtliQ shall indemnify BlueOrchid against third-party claims that the Deliverables infringe any intellectual property right, save where such claim arises from Client Data or modifications made by BlueOrchid.

## 12. DELAY

12.1 If AtliQ fails to complete a Milestone by its scheduled date for reasons solely attributable to AtliQ, BlueOrchid shall be entitled to liquidated damages of 0.5% of the relevant Milestone Fee for each complete week of delay, subject to a maximum of 5% of that Milestone Fee.
12.2 No liquidated damages shall be payable for any delay caused by BlueOrchid, its vendors, or a force majeure event.
12.3 Liquidated damages under this Clause shall be BlueOrchid's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

## 13. DATA PROTECTION

13.1 AtliQ shall process personal data contained in Client Data only for the purposes of the Pilot and in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and any other applicable data protection law, including the laws applicable to Properties located outside India.
13.2 AtliQ shall implement reasonable security safeguards and shall notify BlueOrchid without undue delay of any personal data breach.
13.3 On completion or termination of the Pilot, AtliQ shall return or delete Client Data as instructed by BlueOrchid.

## 14. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION

14.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India.
14.2 Any dispute shall first be referred to senior management of both Parties for amicable settlement within thirty (30) days.
14.3 Failing settlement, the dispute shall be finally resolved by arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, by a sole arbitrator mutually appointed. The seat and venue of arbitration shall be Mumbai and the language shall be English.
14.4 Subject to the above, the courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

## 15. GENERAL

15.1 **Force Majeure.** Neither Party shall be liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond its reasonable control.
15.2 **Assignment.** Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other, not to be unreasonably withheld.
15.3 **Independent Contractors.** The Parties are independent contractors; nothing herein creates a partnership or agency.
15.4 **Notices.** Notices shall be in writing to the addresses above, marked to the attention of Ms. Farah Sayed (BlueOrchid) and the Chief Executive Officer (AtliQ).
15.5 **Entire Agreement.** This Agreement, with its Annexures, is the entire agreement between the Parties regarding the Pilot.
15.6 **Future Engagement.** Upon successful completion of the Pilot, the Parties may enter into a master services agreement for a full-scale rollout on terms to be mutually agreed.

## ANNEXURE A
Properties**" means the twelve (12) hotels listed in Annexure B
Milestone Fee**" means the fee attributable to a Milestone as set out in Annexure C
